# teams agent publish

Package an Agent 365 blueprint for upload to the Microsoft 365 admin center

## Usage

```
teams agent publish [name] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | [OPTIONAL] Agent name; only needed if this folder has no a365 config file | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
